articles.title: Russia says it launched 'massive' strikes on Kyiv, other areas of Ukraine
articles.summary: Russia’s defence ministry said the targets included missile and drone facilities in Kyiv and sites in several other regions.

articles.title: Ukraine faces a shortage of troops to relieve tired fighters at the front
articles.summary: Draft avoidance and desertion have compounded mobilisation problems, limiting Ukraine’s ability to use gains from drone technology.

articles.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
articles.summary: The glide bomb hit two civilian buses in Kramatorsk, and officials also reported casualties in a nearby village.

articles.title: Ukraine says it hit Russia's largest oil refinery
articles.summary: The military said the Omsk facility, around 2,500 km from Ukraine, is operated by Gazpromneft and supplies fuel to the Russian army.

articles.title: Hormuz transits at lowest in over two months after attacks, data shows
articles.summary: Kpler counted seven commodity vessels crossing on Tuesday, the fewest since 23 July, after tanker attacks reached a wartime weekly high.

articles.title: Iran's IRGC strikes tanker and threatens to target ships beyond Hormuz
articles.summary: The Revolutionary Guards claimed responsibility for setting a tanker ablaze and warned they could pursue vessels elsewhere in the region.

articles.title: Tensions and Chaos in Albania parliament and in Tirana streets, as ruling party adopts contested law reducing number of municipalities

articles.title: Kapidzic Announces New Majority in Sarajevo: SDA, SBiH and DF Begin Government Formation

articles.title: Vice President of RS on Election Results: Bosniaks Are Politically Marginalized in Republika Srpska, We Lost the Protection Mechanism
articles.summary: Duraković said new voting technologies improved transparency but alleged that vote buying remained a problem.

articles.title: SDA begins coalition talks in Zenica-Doboj Canton, seeks partners for comfortable majority
articles.summary: The party said it had secured 43,877 votes and 14 seats in the Zenica-Doboj Canton Assembly.

articles.title: Serbian Watchdog Claims Voters’ Rights Under Threat Ahead of Elections
articles.summary: Election monitor CRTA alleged intimidation, unlawful surveillance and unequal media coverage ahead of the 25 October vote.

articles.title: “Nova” staff accuse the new owner of imposing a chief editor just ahead of the election
articles.summary: Employees objected to the appointment of Marko Stjepanović as editor-in-chief ahead of the election.

articles.title: Justina Shiroka Pula, Another Woman at Kosovo’s Helm
articles.summary: A last-minute agreement between the two largest parties averted another election as the deadline to choose a president neared.

articles.title: Russian attack kills 6 in Ukraine's Kharkiv, shatters residences
articles.summary: Regional authorities said nearly 60 people were injured after three bombs struck different areas of Kharkiv.

articles.summary: Russian strikes halted a major steel plant and mines in Kryvyi Rih as the government faced its largest budget crisis since the invasion.

articles.title: Rubio says war in Ukraine is at a dangerous stalemate
articles.summary: Speaking in Lisbon, the US secretary of state said Washington would keep seeking a permanent negotiated settlement.

articles.title: Klitschko, Estonian Defense Minister discuss strengthening air defense, military aid to Kyiv, Ukraine
articles.summary: Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko called for faster delivery of air-defence missiles amid attacks on the capital’s infrastructure.

articles.title: Iran is now ‘satisfied’ with Trump Route, Armenia Foreign Minister says

articles.title: PM Pashinyan: Peace between Armenia and Azerbaijan is an accomplished fact
articles.summary: At a CIS summit, Nikol Pashinyan said the initialled peace agreement confirmed that neither country had territorial claims against the other.

articles.title: Production starts in Azerbaijan’s first Israeli weapons factory
articles.summary: Israeli firm ARI Arms is producing M-4 type rifles in a joint venture involving the two countries’ defence ministries.

articles.title: Trilateral meeting of Azerbaijani, Russian and Iranian presidents begins
articles.summary: The three leaders were expected to discuss the North–South transport corridor.

articles.title: Azerbaijan students launch school strike over hijab restrictions

articles.title: Anti-Government Protester Says He Left Georgia Following Abuse by Police Officers
articles.summary: Sergey Kancheli alleged that six officers took him to a cemetery, beat him and threatened him with a gun.

articles.title: SSSG Says Wanted Georgian Arrested Over Alleged Plot to Carry Out ‘Subversive Acts’ Linked to October 4 Unrest

articles.title: Georgian singer alleges police assaulted him and pressured him to confess to crimes

articles.title: Kobakhidze to EU: Moldova and Ukraine are only ahead of Georgia ‘in negative indicators’

articles.title: ‘They beat us’: More inmates claim abuse from staff as Georgia’s prisoner protests continue
articles.summary: The inmates said they were protesting in solidarity with a prisoner who accused guards of rape; the penitentiary service denied the allegations.

articles.title: Kazakhstan Defense Ministry Inspection Leads to 13 Criminal Cases in Wake of Soldiers’ Deaths

articles.title: Central Asian countries agree on reservoir operations for 2026-2027
articles.summary: At an Interstate Commission for Water Coordination meeting in Turkmenbashi, members agreed water withdrawal volumes and reservoir schedules for the 2026–27 non-growing season.

articles.title: Kyrgyzstan Court Jails Kadyr Atambayev and Temirlan Sultanbekov

articles.title: Former Transport Minister Nurlan Sulaimanov released on travel restrictions

articles.title: Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan to strengthen inter-parliamentary relations

articles.title: Ukrainian journalist says Austrian police held him at gunpoint, accused him of spying for Kyiv

articles.title: Estonia’s KrattWorks crafting Shahed-like dummy drone for target practice

articles.summary: Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna said NPM Silmet should set a deadline for ending Russian raw-material purchases after receiving EU backing.

articles.title: Germany's Left to start Berlin coalition talks after antisemitism deal

articles.title: European intelligence services weigh possible fallout after German ex-spy chief's arrest

articles.title: The German defense company, Rheinmetall, has purchased the Damen Mangalia shipyard in Romania

articles.title: Sweden's red-green parties head into first post-election meeting
articles.summary: Leaders of the Social Democrats, Left, Centre and Green parties met amid a deadlock over forming a government.

articles.title: Putin Vows to Help End Middle East War in Talks With Pezeshkian

articles.title: EXCLUSIVE: Lebanon's Hezbollah gets $200 million from Iran to help displaced, sources say

articles.title: Tanker hit by multiple projectiles in Gulf off Qatar, maritime agency says

articles.title: Yemen's Houthis say they attacked Riyadh airport with ballistic missile

articles.title: Syria weighs military aid for Saudi Arabia amid Yemen war, sources say

articles.title: DEM Party Urges Swift Peace Steps, Warns Over Hasakah

articles.title: UN envoy warns Yemen has returned to ‘full-scale war’, urges dialogue

articles.title: EU trade chief seeks ‘tangible outcomes’ in China talks

articles.title: Members of Kyrgyz Parliament participating in OSCE PA sessions
articles.summary: Two Kyrgyz lawmakers attended the Parliamentary Assembly’s autumn session in Andorra la Vella, held from 7 to 9 October.
